title: bug: the JetBrains board's previous-arrow on a WORKING card, and Previous in its detail dialog, ask the daemon for WORKING to AWAITING_APPROVAL, which /ws always refuses, so the card never moves and the typed reason is lost
description:
Filed by the 11-03 #2 defect hunt (task-2597ac6f). This is a client-wire mismatch: the plugin sends a status move that the daemon's transition table has never allowed.

PROBLEM
In moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/MoeToolWindowPanel.kt at HEAD 946358a8:
- :532 sets workflowOrder = listOf("BACKLOG", "PLANNING", "AWAITING_APPROVAL", "WORKING", "REVIEW", "DONE").
- getPreviousStatus at :537-540 therefore returns "AWAITING_APPROVAL" for "WORKING".
- handlePrevious at :564-577 first prompts for a reason. For any status except DONE or REVIEW it then calls service.updateTaskStatus(task.id, "AWAITING_APPROVAL", order), and nothing sends the reason.
- That callback is wired to every card outside Backlog (:675) and to TaskDetailDialog's Previous button (:635-637). Every WORKING card shows the arrow, and it fails every time.

On the daemon side, the /ws UPDATE_TASK guard at packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:498-513 rejects the move. Its VALID_TRANSITIONS entry is WORKING: ['REVIEW', 'PLANNING', 'BACKLOG', 'BLOCKED'], and the guard throws "Cannot move task from WORKING to AWAITING_APPROVAL. Allowed: REVIEW, PLANNING, BACKLOG, BLOCKED". The plugin surfaces that only as a generic error notification (MoeMessageDispatcher.kt:198-206), so the card stays put.

AWAITING_APPROVAL is display-mapped into the Planning column, so "one column left" from Working means PLANNING. The daemon allows WORKING to PLANNING.

EVIDENCE
(a) Daemon-side repro on HEAD 946358a8, run in a git-archive snapshot under /tmp, never in the shared checkout:
`cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/server/zzHunt2597B.prevArrow.test.ts` sends the exact UPDATE_TASK frame the plugin's MoeCommandSender builds for a WORKING task. The reply is:
  [PREV] reply = {"type":"ERROR","message":"Cannot move task from WORKING to AWAITING_APPROVAL. Allowed: REVIEW, PLANNING, BACKLOG, BLOCKED","operation":"UPDATE_TASK","context":{"taskId":"task-1"}}
and the task stays WORKING. Test and key lines: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/B/zzHunt2597B.prevArrow.test.ts and /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/B/zzHunt2597B.prevArrow.key-lines.txt.
(b) The client lines cited above, at 946358a8.

FIX DIRECTION
JetBrains only; leave the daemon unchanged.
- Move the previous-target rule into a small pure helper, e.g. toolwindow/BoardMoves.kt (the name is free), that returns only daemon-legal back-moves:
  - WORKING goes to PLANNING.
  - AWAITING_APPROVAL goes to PLANNING.
  - PLANNING goes to BACKLOG.
  - REVIEW and DONE keep using REOPEN_TASK, as today.
  - BLOCKED, BACKLOG and unknown statuses return null: no arrow and no reason prompt.
- Use the helper for both the card arrow and the detail dialog's Previous button.
- The reason prompt for WORKING to PLANNING must either reach the daemon or be dropped:
  - Reaching the daemon means, for example, sending reopenReason in the UPDATE_TASK updates. First check it is not on WebSocketServer.ts UPDATE_TASK_DENYLIST (:61 onwards).
  - Otherwise, do not prompt for that move.
- VS Code may have its own twin of this bug. It is out of scope here.

FILES
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/MoeToolWindowPanel.kt
- a new moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/BoardMoves.kt
- test: moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/BoardMovesTest.kt
These files are disjoint from the other rows filed by this hunt. Run Gradle only under the jetbrains-gradle lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease, mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box).

VERIFICATION
`cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` (gradlew.bat on Windows), under the jetbrains-gradle lease.
definitionOfDone: The helper's previous target for WORKING is PLANNING. For every status it returns only a move that the daemon's /ws VALID_TRANSITIONS allows at 946358a8, or reopen for REVIEW/DONE, or null for BLOCKED/BACKLOG/unknown. A JUnit test asserts each status.

MoeToolWindowPanel's card arrow and TaskDetailDialog's Previous button both get their target from the helper. A status with no legal previous move shows no arrow and no reason prompt. A typed reason is either sent to the daemon or never asked for.
`cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits 0 under the jetbrains-gradle lease, and the new test fails on HEAD 946358a8, where WORKING maps to AWAITING_APPROVAL.

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 1. A pure helper plus its JUnit test, red first. Model it on toolwindow/DoneColumnClear.kt and DoneColumnClearTest.kt: a pure `object` in com.moe.toolwindow whose KDoc cites the daemon line it mirrors, tested headlessly.

(a) Create moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/BoardMoves.kt with:
- `internal sealed interface PreviousMove`, with two cases:
  - `object Reopen`: REOPEN_TASK with the typed reason, which the daemon routes to BACKLOG.
  - `data class Status(val target: String)`: a plain UPDATE_TASK status move.
- `internal object BoardMoves`, with:
  - `fun previous(status: String): PreviousMove?`
  - `fun hasPrevious(status: String): Boolean = previous(status) != null`.

For the RED run, give previous() TODAY's rule, copied from MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:532-540: the workflowOrder neighbour, so WORKING returns Status("AWAITING_APPROVAL"), with REVIEW and DONE as Reopen.

(b) Create moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/BoardMovesTest.kt with exact assertions for each status:
- BACKLOG gives null.
- PLANNING gives Status("BACKLOG").
- AWAITING_APPROVAL gives Status("PLANNING").
- WORKING gives Status("PLANNING").
- REVIEW and DONE give Reopen.
- BLOCKED, ARCHIVED, "" and "NOT_A_STATUS" give null.

Add one legality test. Copy the daemon's /ws VALID_TRANSITIONS map at 946358a8 verbatim (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:498-507; cite it in a comment). Then assert that, for every status in that map, previous() returns either null, Reopen (REVIEW/DONE only), or a Status whose target the map allows from that status. A future edit to an illegal move then fails.

Run red, holding the jetbrains-gradle lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease):
`gradlew.bat -p moe-jetbrains test --tests com.moe.toolwindow.BoardMovesTest --rerun`
Expect the WORKING assertion (expected PLANNING, was AWAITING_APPROVAL) and the legality test to fail. Keep that tail: it is DoD 3's evidence that the test fails on HEAD 946358a8.

(c) GREEN: change previous() to an explicit `when`. The `else` branch returns null: BACKLOG, BLOCKED, ARCHIVED and unknown statuses have no previous move. Re-run the same command; it must be green.

Error handling: previous() never throws. An unknown or empty status is simply null, meaning no arrow and no prompt.
implementationPlan.note: BoardMoves + BoardMovesTest. Red: 2 of 7 failed (workingGoesToPlanning, legality) on the old workflowOrder rule; green after the explicit when. Note gradlew.bat lives in moe-jetbrains/, not the repo root.

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 2. Route the card arrow and the detail dialog's Previous button through the helper.

(a) moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/MoeToolWindowPanel.kt
- Delete getPreviousStatus (:537-540) and keep getNextStatus and workflowOrder for Next. Next is correct and out of scope.
- handlePrevious (:564-577) becomes:
  1. `val move = BoardMoves.previous(task.status) ?: return`.
  2. Prompt for the reason exactly as today (moe.message.previousReason / previousReasonTitle). The prompt also confirms the click.
  3. If the reason is null or blank, return.
  4. Then `when (move)`:
     - PreviousMove.Reopen: service.reopenTask(task.id, reason). This is unchanged and carries the reason.
     - PreviousMove.Status: first service.addTaskComment(task.id, reason), so the reason reaches the daemon as a task comment the next claimer sees. Then service.updateTaskStatus(task.id, move.target, task.order).
  Both service methods already exist (MoeProjectService.kt:523 and :561), so no new wire command is needed. reopenReason was considered and rejected: it needs a new MoeCommandSender/MoeProjectService parameter, which takes this row past 4 files.
- The TaskDetailDialog Previous callback (prevCb, :636) becomes `if (BoardMoves.hasPrevious(task.status)) { t: Task -> handlePrevious(t) } else null`. TaskDetailDialog.kt itself is NOT edited; task-37e03b91 and task-ac587df5 own hunks there.

(b) moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/board/TaskColumn.kt:174
- Pass `onPrevious = onPrevious?.takeIf { BoardMoves.hasPrevious(task.status) }` per card. A card whose status has no legal back-move, e.g. a BLOCKED card in the Working column, then shows no arrow. TaskCard.kt:252 draws the arrow only when the callback is non-null, so TaskCard needs no change.
- Keep the column-level `if (!isBacklog)` at MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:675 as it is.

Error handling:
- A daemon refusal, e.g. a PLANNING WIP limit, still surfaces through the existing ERROR notification path (MoeMessageDispatcher.kt:198-206).
- TaskCard keeps its safeCallback wrapper.
- If the move is refused after the comment lands, the comment stays. That is acceptable: it records what the human asked for.

Do not touch VS Code, the daemon, TaskDetailDialog.kt, BoardStyles or TaskCard.kt.
implementationPlan.note: getPreviousStatus deleted; handlePrevious, detail-dialog prevCb and per-card arrow all use BoardMoves. Status moves send the reason as a task comment first. Compile is covered by the step-3 gradle run.

implementationPlan.description:

Use --rerun because an UP-TO-DATE :test task executes zero tests (mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box).

- total tests > 0, with 0 failures and 0 errors;
- TEST-com.moe.toolwindow.BoardMovesTest.xml lists the new cases.
Quote those totals in the evidence. The unit tests need no daemon or proxy dist.

If a red run shows a socket MessageIOException in the Gradle daemon log, it is the known IPC flake: re-run once.

Never `--stop` the Gradle daemon, and never clean shared build output. Nothing in TypeScript changes, so no npm or daemon gate applies.

Step 1's red run covers DoD 3's fails-on-946358a8 clause.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review, once. Load the adversarial-self-review skill, then read this task's diff as an attacker. Check each item:
(1) `grep -n 'getPreviousStatus' -r moe-jetbrains/src` finds nothing. Every Previous path (card arrow, detail-dialog button, handlePrevious) goes through BoardMoves.
(2) Each target previous() returns is legal under the daemon's /ws VALID_TRANSITIONS, re-read at the current target tip in packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts. If the daemon table has changed since 946358a8, say so in a comment rather than silently diverging.
(3) A typed reason is never dropped. Reopen sends it with REOPEN_TASK, and Status sends it as a task comment before the move. A blank or cancelled prompt sends nothing.
(4) A BLOCKED card shows no arrow, and nothing that has no legal move prompts for a reason.
(5) The Next arrow and the AWAITING_APPROVAL Next path (BoardApproval.approveRendered) behave as before.
(6) The test asserts exact values and the legality table, so a no-op or reverted mapping fails it.
(7) The diff touches only this plan's 4 files and stays clear of TaskDetailDialog.kt, Models.kt and MoeJson.kt, which task-37e03b91, task-40813cc1 and task-ac587df5 own.
implementationPlan.note: Self-review: no getPreviousStatus left; daemon VALID_TRANSITIONS at current tip identical to the test's copy; Reopen carries the reason, Status sends a comment first, blank/cancel sends nothing; BLOCKED/BACKLOG/unknown get no arrow and no prompt; Next path untouched; diff is the 4 planned files only.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Rejected options:
(1) Send the typed reason as reopenReason in the UPDATE_TASK updates. /ws accepts it, since reopenReason is not on UPDATE_TASK_DENYLIST and the BLOCKED-exit path reads safeUpdates.reopenReason. But it needs a new optional parameter on MoeCommandSender.updateTaskStatus and MoeProjectService.updateTaskStatus, plus a payload test, which takes the row to 6-7 files.
(2) Drop the reason prompt for status moves. That makes WORKING to PLANNING a one-click unassignment of a live worker, with no confirmation.
(3) Route AWAITING_APPROVAL to REJECT_TASK. That changes the event semantics (PLAN_REJECTED), and the bug does not need it.
Chosen: keep the prompt (it doubles as a confirmation), send the reason as a task comment through the existing addTaskComment, then the legal status move.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- The /ws VALID_TRANSITIONS map is at packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:498-507. WORKING allows REVIEW, PLANNING, BACKLOG and BLOCKED; AWAITING_APPROVAL allows WORKING and PLANNING; PLANNING allows AWAITING_APPROVAL, BACKLOG, BLOCKED and ARCHIVED.
- TaskCard.kt:252 draws the arrow only when the callback is non-null.
- TaskColumn.kt:174 passes one column-level callback to every card, so per-card visibility is decided there.
- TaskDetailDialog's Previous button is the prevCb that MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:636 builds.
- The board drag (MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:606/:625) already sends plain status moves with no prompt.
- toolwindow/DoneColumnClear.kt is the precedent for a pure, headlessly tested board rule.
planningNotes.risks:
- The comment and the move are two /ws messages. If the move is refused, for example by a WIP limit, the comment stays. That is acceptable and informative.
- The test's copy of VALID_TRANSITIONS can drift from the daemon. The self-review re-reads the daemon table at the current tip.
- Gradle traps on this shared Windows box: use --rerun, re-run once on the IPC MessageIOException flake, and hold the jetbrains-gradle lease only around a run.
- The VS Code twin is out of scope.
